purpose: Teach: 功績/加わり/根幹/取り入れる/利回り/多岐/補充/一大

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Quiet, measured opening. Pause between clauses. Weight behind each phrase, like he's settling into something he knows. No performance, just fact. The confidence of long experience.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。社内に若手が加わり、活気があります。
lines.en: Yes. We've brought on younger staff, and there's real energy in the office.
lines.style: Respectful but direct. Sits a little straighter. Pride without boasting — he's reporting what he can see. Steady eye contact, careful diction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 根幹を守れ。流行を取り入れるのは、その後だ。
lines.en: Protect your foundation first. Trends come later.
lines.style: Firmer tone now, almost gentle insistence. Each word deliberate. Leans forward slightly — not aggressive, but wanting to be certain he lands this. A teacher correcting without condescension.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 資産運用、利回り重視で、多岐にわたって検討中です。
lines.en: We're reviewing asset management strategies with yield as the priority, exploring multiple approaches.
lines.style: More formal register. Measured, professional pace. Slight hesitation before 'multiple' — weighing options. Demonstrates thoughtfulness, not uncertainty. Quiet conviction underneath the corporate language.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 補充は急ぐな。一大事業、慎重に進めろ。
lines.en: Don't rush the expansion. Major decisions need care.
lines.style: Final word — slightly lower, trailing into something heavier. Unhurried. The advice lands because he doesn't press. Breath pause before the close, like he's giving it room to settle.
